title: Additivity of a Fourier component
statement: Let $\Omega$ and $\iota$ be finite nonempty sets, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $(\psi_a)_{a\in\iota}$ be a basis of real-valued functions on $\Omega$ that contains the constant-one function and is orthonormal for the inner product weighted by $\pi$. For any $n\in\mathbb N$, real-valued functions $f,g$ on $\Omega^n$, and coordinate set $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, the Fourier component of $f+g$ supported on $S$ is the sum of the Fourier components of $f$ and $g$ supported on $S$.
hypotheses_covered: Basis is orthonormal for the $\pi$-weighted inner product
